LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 WORD CLASS: CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why do we join sentences?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech
2. use conjunctions in a variety of contexts for effective oral and written communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 WORD CLASS: CONJUNCTIONS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions for Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use conjunctions in a variety of contexts for effective oral and written communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Word Class: Conjunctions important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we join sentences?
2. Which words do we use to join sentences?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify conjunctions correctly in oral and written texts for fluency in speech
2. use conjunctions in a variety of contexts for effective oral and written communication
